pm-github already fail-closes complete-corpus receipts, but its production argv and user-facing diagnostics still use the deprecated list-all alias and its declared pm CLI/SDK floors predate 2026.8.20.

Create failing exact-argv and alias-free real installed-CLI tests first; replace only the deprecated invocation and terminology; retain strict full unbounded fail-closed receipt validation; use top-level TypeScript imports and no any/dynamic imports; pin dev CLI/SDK and set peer/manifest floors to 2026.8.20; run release:check, exact measured-source coverage, pm health, reconcile, validate, npm/bun packed acceptance, dependency/vulnerability/privacy checks; document exact evidence and link the package PR plus companion item pm-cli-website-cbyb; do not merge or publish while pm-github-zqad or pm-github-v2kt blocks release
Run the production completePmListArgs vector with pm CLI 2026.8.20 and inspect stderr; scan index.ts, README.md, and complete-corpus tests for list-all.

Production invokes explicit unbounded canonical pm list --all --json with full/body/strict receipts; no alias deprecation reaches stderr; source, tests, docs, generated output, package dependency, peer floor, and manifest floor agree on pm CLI/SDK 2026.8.20.

Baseline: complete corpus verification is strict and release-tested, but completePmListArgs emits list-all; README and errors name the alias; dev dependency is 2026.8.17, peer/manifest floors are 2026.8.3, and installed node_modules is stale at 2026.8.15.
Deprecated diagnostics can pollute machine stderr and stale compatibility floors allow hosts that do not provide the canonical contract this package now requires.
